note: Shoshone NF campground on the Buffalo Bill Scenic Byway 29 miles west of Cody and 23 miles east of Yellowstone's East Entrance, among cottonwoods and junipers between the highway and the North Fork of the Shoshone River. Fly-fishing for rainbow and Yellowstone cutthroat; grizzly country. --Claude
